weapons.name: frag_grenade_mp
weapons.effect: Cook it, throw it; it bounces and goes off on a timer.

weapons.name: semtex_mp
weapons.effect: Sticks to whatever it hits, then goes off.

weapons.name: throwingknife_mp
weapons.effect: Kills in one hit; walk over it to pick it back up.

weapons.name: claymore_mp
weapons.effect: A tripwire mine that blasts forward when an enemy walks by.

weapons.name: c4_mp
weapons.effect: A charge you place, then set off yourself.

weapons.name: flash_grenade_mp
weapons.effect: Blinds and deafens anyone caught near it.

weapons.name: concussion_grenade_mp
weapons.effect: Slows and staggers anyone caught near it.

weapons.name: smoke_grenade_mp
weapons.effect: A thick smoke screen that blocks sight.

attachments.name: Red Dot Sight
attachments.effect: A red-dot sight: a cleaner sight picture, no zoom.

attachments.name: Silencer
attachments.effect: Firing keeps you off enemy maps and carries less far; shorter damage range.

attachments.name: Grenade Launcher
attachments.effect: An underbarrel grenade launcher: raise it with the alternate weapon key.

attachments.name: FMJ
attachments.effect: Full metal jacket rounds punch through cover.

attachments.name: Shotgun
attachments.effect: An underbarrel shotgun: raise it with the alternate weapon key.

attachments.name: Grip
attachments.effect: A foregrip that steadies the recoil.

attachments.name: Rapid Fire
attachments.effect: Rapid fire: the gun cycles faster.

attachments.name: Akimbo
attachments.effect: A gun in each hand: twice the magazine and the fire rate, but no aiming down the sights.

attachments.name: Tactical Knife
attachments.effect: A tactical knife in the off hand for quicker knife strikes.

attachments.name: Holographic Sight
attachments.effect: A holographic sight: a clear sight picture, no zoom.

attachments.name: Thermal
attachments.effect: A thermal scope: warm bodies glow, even through smoke.

attachments.name: Heartbeat Sensor
attachments.effect: A heartbeat sensor that shows nearby enemies while you hold the gun.

attachments.name: Extended Mags
attachments.effect: Extended magazines: more rounds before a reload.

perks.name: Marathon
perks.effect: Sprint without tiring. Out of combat you run 5% faster.
perks.pro_effect: Out of combat you run another 5% faster.
perks.stack_effect: Additive: each copy makes you 5% faster out of combat (up to 15%).

perks.name: Sleight of Hand
perks.effect: Reload in half the time; spells in your hands cast 15% quicker.
perks.stack_effect: Diminishing: spells cast 15%, 22% then 26% quicker. Reloads stay at half.

perks.name: Scavenger
perks.effect: Every kill worth experience brings a magazine back for every gun; 25% more gold from bodies you loot.
perks.pro_effect: Another 25% more gold from bodies you loot.
perks.stack_effect: Additive: each copy adds 25% more gold. Magazines come back once a kill.

perks.name: Bling
perks.effect: Rails for one more attachment: two on your primary (MW2's Bling).
perks.pro_effect: Your secondary takes a second attachment too.
perks.stack_effect: Special: each copy adds an attachment to the primary, up to four with three Rails; never two of one kind (two sights, two underbarrels).

perks.name: One Man Army
perks.effect: Switch kits even in combat; others wait until combat ends.
perks.pro_effect: The field editor is ready again in 30 minutes instead of an hour.

perks.name: Stopping Power
perks.effect: Bullets hit 40% harder (not explosives); the weapon in your hands hits 20% harder.
perks.pro_effect: The weapon in your hands hits 35% harder.
perks.stack_effect: Does not stack: guns are everyone's baseline.

perks.name: Lightweight
perks.effect: Move 12% faster; falls hurt half as much.
perks.pro_effect: Fire sooner after a sprint (30% quicker).

perks.name: Hardline
perks.effect: Killstreaks need one kill fewer; 10% more experience from kills.

perks.name: Cold-Blooded
perks.effect: Creatures never call their friends to help against you, and hear your gunfire from less far.

perks.name: Danger Close
perks.pro_effect: Your killstreaks' air support hits 25% harder too.

perks.name: Commando
perks.effect: Your knife lunge reaches 40 yards instead of 20.

perks.name: Steady Aim
perks.pro_effect: Jumping no longer widens your hip fire.

perks.name: Scrambler
perks.effect: Creatures' spells at you cast 20% slower.

perks.name: Ninja
perks.effect: Creatures notice you at 70% of the distance; your stealth is 3 yards harder to see through.
perks.pro_effect: Your stealth is 2 more yards harder to see through.
perks.stack_effect: Diminishing: stealth 3, 4.5 then 5.25 yards harder to see. Notice distance does not stack.

perks.name: SitRep
perks.effect: See stealthed enemies from 5 yards farther.

perks.name: Last Stand
perks.effect: A fatal hit leaves you down with your pistol drawn: fight on while you wait to be revived.

deathstreaks.name: Copycat
deathstreaks.effect: After 4 deaths without a kill, your next life starts with your killer's kit.

deathstreaks.name: Painkiller
deathstreaks.effect: After 3 deaths without a kill, you take a third of the damage for 10 seconds after you return.

deathstreaks.name: Martyrdom
deathstreaks.effect: After 4 deaths without a kill, you drop a live grenade where you fall.

deathstreaks.name: Final Stand
deathstreaks.effect: After 4 deaths without a kill, a fatal hit leaves you down with a pistol; hold on 10 seconds and you get back up at half health.
